900.2.10(304).explanation: Exception R 304 adds no site-specific provisions of its own. Instead, parts of Section 12(2) 70 of the former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 prevail across the exception area, and sixteen named addresses on Cowan, Dunn, Spencer, Springhurst, Temple and Thornburn Avenues are each governed by their own site-specific City of Toronto by-law. MaxBLD does not evaluate these prevailing by-laws, so results on these lands should be confirmed with the City.
